definitions.explanation: The prevention of heat transfer between areas, typically to maintain indoor temperature and improve energy efficiency in buildings.

examples.english: To install insulation material in the walls.

examples.japanese: {断熱|だんねつ}⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: To replace with windows that have high insulation performance.

examples.japanese: {断熱|だんねつ}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{冷暖房費|れいだんぼうひ}→冷暖房費：29720_reidanbouhi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Insulation work can save on heating and cooling costs.

・{断熱|だんねつ}⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧ (insulation material)
・{断熱|だんねつ}⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧ (insulation performance)
・{断熱|だんねつ}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (insulation work)
・{断熱|だんねつ}⟦リフォーム→リフォーム：08821_rifoomu⟧ (insulation renovation)
・⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧{断熱|だんねつ} (high insulation)
・{断熱|だんねつ}⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧ (insulated glass)

・⟦{省|しょう}エネ→省エネ：06308_shouene⟧ (energy saving)
